 By Iris Kwok
Los Angeles Times (TNS) 
 Nov 12, 2026 
 3 hrs ago

 As the clock ticks down for the Senate to pass the so-called Sunshine Protection Act to mandate year-round daylight saving time in most of the United States, President Donald Trump on Wednesday said he planned to “keep fighting” for the change.
 In July, the House, in a lopsided bipartisan vote, approved a measure to make year-round daylight saving time the default for most of the United States. But its companion bill remains stalled in the Senate.
